title: André De Shields performs “I Got Life” during the HAIR 50th Anniversa...
transcript: I got a lot to say. I got. I got crazy ways. Don't I got a million dollar charm, cousin? I got. I got my head, I got my head, I got my brain. I've got my head. I've got my ball in my head, my fingers in my head. I got my hair, I got my hair, got my beat, got my toe, got my middle, got my love. Let's go. Oh, oh.
